output.headline: Kowalski hat-trick powers Harbour City past wasteful Ironvale
output.text: Ironvale Athletic should have led inside 2 minutes, but Zeke Mbeki's 0.876 xG effort from 2.5m was blocked. Mbeki eventually scored on 30 minutes, finishing under pressure at 96.1 km/h (xg 0.188) after Luca Romero's 31.7m pass with difficulty 53. His 0.459 chance on 33 minutes was saved. Leo Marchetti equalised on 49 minutes from just 0.024 xG. Dani Kowalski then took over. He scored at 97.9 km/h on 62 minutes, added a 0.057 finish on 81 minutes and closed it out from 2.5m (0.79 xG) for 4-1. Harbour City's press (PPDA 8.5 vs 10.3) gave them control, and momentum ended at 75. Ironvale outscored them on xG, 1.76 to 1.26, but Mbeki turned 1.74 xG into 1 goal.
